files.read.file.says: Reading one file from the pod's folder.

files.write.file.says: Writing one file into the pod's folder.

files.write.rename.says: Moving a finished file into place, so a half-written file is never seen.

files.hash.sha256.says: Fingerprinting a file's content to tell whether it changed.

files.encrypt.says: Scrambling a file with the pod's secret before it is written (encrypted pods only).

files.decrypt.says: Unscrambling a file with the pod's secret as it is read (encrypted pods only).

files.commit.index.says: Writing the pod's list of its encrypted files (encrypted pods only).

pod.match.says: Judging which records in the pod are the same thing recorded twice.

pod.unclaimedprofiles.says: Finding the people named in an import's records whom the person has not yet said are, or are not, themselves.

pod.judge.says: Claiming one confirmed profile as the pod's owner, by filing the judgment that says so.

pod.profilestied.says: Looking up which profiles the person has already said are, or are not, themselves.

store.query.says: Questions put to the pod's fact store, many of them: the time one or more of them was in progress.

union.loadfiles.says: Loading the pod's files into memory as facts.

union.add.says: Adding facts to the pod's in-memory facts.

union.drop.says: Dropping facts from the pod's in-memory facts.

union.removesubjects.says: Removing everything known about some records from the in-memory facts.

union.select.says: Asking the in-memory facts a question that returns rows.

union.construct.says: Asking the in-memory facts a question that returns new facts.

union.holds.says: Checking whether the in-memory facts hold something.
